about_short_description.short_description: AI powered task management for busy professionals

product.name: Hoop AI Task Management Platform
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automatically captures and organizes tasks from meetings, Slack, and email into a unified task list.

product.name: Hoop macOS App
product.description: A macOS application that transcribes audio from meetings and captures tasks without recording video or audio.

product.name: Hoop Slack Integration
product.description: An integration that uses AI to identify and capture tasks from Slack messages, channels, and direct messages.

product.name: Hoop Email Integration
product.description: An integration that automatically identifies and extracts tasks from Google Workspace email inboxes.

product.name: Meeting Bot for Windows Users
product.description: A meeting bot that attends virtual meetings to capture tasks, summaries, and transcripts for Windows users.
